# EarthyGlow

> EarthyGlow is a small Dutch candle shop. Naomi pours every candle by hand in the Netherlands from soy wax: flower candles, seasonal scented candles, unscented sculptural candles and wax melts.

The shop is available in Dutch, English and German. Prices are in euros. It ships within the Netherlands and to other EU countries.

## Shop

- [Shop in Dutch](https://www.earthyglow.nl/nl/shop/): all products
- [Shop in English](https://www.earthyglow.nl/en/shop/): all products
- [Shop in German](https://www.earthyglow.nl/de/shop/): all products

## Collections (English)

- [Scented tealights](https://www.earthyglow.nl/en/shop/little-glow/): flower candles in boxes and baskets
- [Scented candles](https://www.earthyglow.nl/en/shop/scented-glow/): seasonal fragrances
- [Fragrance-free candles](https://www.earthyglow.nl/en/shop/natural-glow/): sculptural unscented shapes
- [Wax melts](https://www.earthyglow.nl/en/shop/wax-melts/): small seasonal shapes for a wax warmer
